summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for:
1. Real-time chat powered by Cloud Firestore snapshot listeners with Room local caching and complete removal of mock/simulated message replies.
2. Real-time email verification via Firebase Auth email verification link with real-time reload status polling and removal of mock OTP simulation.
3. Campus Admin name updated to 'Mohammed Mishal M' with a 'Show Badges' toggle (default OFF) across Profile Settings and Admin Console, hiding officer badges and titles from non-admin viewers unless enabled.
